components.name: Numerical Switchbox

components.name: PID Controller
components.desc: A basic PID controller. The proportional, integral and derivative gains can be set in the property panel.

components.name: SR Latch
components.desc: An SR latch that can be set and reset using two on/off inputs.

components.name: JK Flip Flop
components.desc: An JK flip flop that can be set and reset using two on/off inputs.

components.name: Capacitor
components.desc: Charges up when receiving an on signal, then discharges over a period of time.

components.name: Blinker
components.desc: Outputs a value that blinks between on and off at a set rate.

components.name: Push To Toggle
components.desc: An on/off switch that is toggled every time a new on signal is sent to its input.

components.name: Composite Write (number)
components.desc: Writes a number value to a selected channel of the composite input.

components.name: Property Toggle
components.desc: Adds a custom on/off toggle that will be seen on the microcontroller's property panel when placed on a vehicle.

components.name: Property Number
components.desc: Adds a custom number input that will be seen on the microcontroller's property panel when placed on a vehicle.

components.name: Delta

components.desc: Has an internal value that will increase and decrease when receiving different signals.

components.name: Modulo (fmod)
components.desc: Outputs the modulo of input A by input B.

components.name: PID Controller (Advanced)
components.desc: A PID controller with variable proportional, integral and derivative gains.

components.name: Composite Write (number)
components.desc: Writes up to 32 numbers to a composite link in a single logic tick. Only connected channels will be modified. The number of inputs and channel to begin writing at can be configured.

components.name: Composite Write (on/off)
components.desc: Writes up to 32 on/off signals to a composite link in a single logic tick. Only connected channels will be modified. The number of inputs and channel to begin writing at can be configured.

components.name: Equal
components.desc: Compares whether or not two numbers are equal within a set accuracy.

components.name: Tooltip Number
components.desc: Displays a number on this microcontroller's tooltip when it is looked at by the player on a spawned vehicle.

components.name: Tooltip On/Off
components.desc: Displays an on/off signal on this microcontroller's tooltip when it is looked at by the player on a spawned vehicle.

components.name: f(x)

components.name: Boolean f(x,y,z,w,a,b,c,d)

components.name: Pulse (Toggle to Push)
components.desc: A switch that outputs a single tick pulse. It can be configured to pulse when being switched from off to on (default), on to off, or always when the input signal changes.

components.name: Timer (TON)
components.desc: Variable input timer. Outputs an on signal when the timer reaches its duration. The timer will reset when off.

components.name: Timer (TOF)
components.desc: Variable input timer. Outputs an on signal when the timer is less than its duration. The timer will reset when off.

components.name: Timer (RTO)
components.desc: Variable input timer. Outputs an on signal when the timer reaches its duration. The timer will not reset until it is signalled.

components.name: Timer (RTF)
components.desc: Variable input timer. Outputs an on signal when the timer is less than its duration. The timer will not reset until it is signalled.

components.name: Composite Switchbox
components.desc: Outputs the first input composite when receiving an on signal, and the second when receiving an off signal.

components.name: Number To Composite Binary
components.desc: Converts a number (rounded) to binary and outputs the bits as composite on/off signals.

components.name: Composite Binary To Number
components.desc: Reads the on/off signals of a composite link and encodes them in the bits of an output number.

components.name: Lua Script
components.desc: Runs a custom lua script for advanced logic and drawing to monitors.

components.name: Video Switchbox
components.desc: Outputs the first input video when receiving an on signal, and the second when receiving an off signal.

components.name: Property Text
components.desc: Adds a custom text input that will be seen on the microcontroller's property panel when placed on a vehicle, for showing player-defined text within a lua script.

components.name: Audio Switchbox
components.desc: Outputs the first input audio when receiving an on signal, and the second when receiving an off signal.
